items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Cassino Simpson on piano... Almost, because I was in it, and I sure was no star! [INTERVIEWEE] Well...

ctx.x: Boy, he was really... He was in this band with Jabbo Smith, that they tried to come in after Louis Armstrong left, to make a tour in Chicago, and Cassino Simpson took over the band.
That's the boy that lost his mind.
